envelope.description: Integrate bounded shutdown while preserving store-health behavior

body.title: Integrate bounded shutdown while preserving store-health behavior
body.summary: Wire watchdog arm/ready before native cleanup into createShutdown and daemon entrypoint. Preserve reentrancy, normal exit and lock-loss no-close/self-kill policy. Log stages and health synchronously. On watchdog launch/ready failure diagnose and self-kill before potentially blocked cleanup. Disconnect clients before awaiting ownership-guarded server close in the new serialized sequence. Reconcile src/db/graph/__tests__/helpers/store-child.ts writePid/createShutdown/server-close wiring so lock-loss and fatal tests exercise the new contract rather than bypass it.
acceptanceChecks: Blocked cleanup and post-bye exit are bounded independently of the event loop.
Watchdog failure self-kills before a blocked closeStores fake is invoked, without a CLI client.
Normal cleanup order and existing lock-loss/fatal termination tests pass.
Repeated signals arm one watchdog; orphaned/foreign run-file ownership remains a visible restart failure.

tests.name: Watchdog arm failure self-kills before blocked native cleanup
Bounded shutdown preserves lock-loss, fatal and normal cleanup behavior
Repeated signals and guarded async close preserve ownership
Store-child fixture exercises owned publication watchdog readiness and guarded close
